interaction_history.overview: A self-conscious bride is tormented by the memory of her husband's dead first wife.
interaction_history.title: Rebecca

interaction_history.overview: An FBI agent (Debra Winger) falls in love with a white supremacist (Tom Berenger) whose group she infiltrates.
interaction_history.title: Betrayed

interaction_history.overview: At a 1962 College, Dean Vernon Wormer is determined to expel the entire Delta Tau Chi Fraternity, but those troublemakers have other plans for him.
interaction_history.title: Animal House

interaction_history.overview: Wallace falls in love with wool-shop owner Wendolene, not suspecting that she (or rather, her dog) is at the head of a fiendish sheep-rustling plot. Gromit is set up and jailed, but his new-found sheepish friend is determine to give Wallace a helping hand in finding out the real truth.
interaction_history.title: Close Shave, A

interaction_history.overview: City Lights is the first silent film that Charlie Chaplin directed after he established himself with sound accompanied films. The film is about a penniless man who falls in love with a flower girl. The film was a great success and today is deemed a cult classic.
interaction_history.title: City Lights

interaction_history.overview: All The King's Men is the story of the rise of politician Willie Stark from a rural county seat to the governor's mansion.
interaction_history.title: All the King's Men

interaction_history.overview: As Rebel leaders map their strategy for an all-out attack on the Emperor's newer, bigger Death Star. Han Solo remains frozen in the cavernous desert fortress of Jabba the Hutt, the most loathsome outlaw in the universe, who is also keeping Princess Leia as a slave girl. Now a master of the Force, Luke Skywalker rescues his friends, but he cannot become a true Jedi Knight until he wages his own crucial battle against Darth Vader, who has sworn to win Luke over to the dark side of the Force.
interaction_history.title: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi

interaction_history.overview: Disturbed Blanche DuBois moves in with her sister in New Orleans and is tormented by her brutish brother-in-law while her reality crumbles around her.
interaction_history.title: Streetcar Named Desire, A

interaction_history.overview: David Huxley is waiting to get a bone he needs for his museum collection. Through a series of strange circumstances, he meets Susan Vance, and the duo have a series of misadventures which include a leopard called Baby.
interaction_history.title: Bringing Up Baby

interaction_history.overview: An African American detective is asked to investigate a murder in a racist southern town.
interaction_history.title: In the Heat of the Night
